sceneBrief: A young Aboriginal adult and a supportive adviser talking at a timber table in a bright community office, natural light and a calm contemporary setting.
a housing adviser and an adult reviewing a rental application at a sunny desk, keys in foreground
an Aboriginal Australian housing support worker and an Aboriginal couple talking on a sunny modest home veranda
an Aboriginal Australian GP having a friendly consultation with an adult patient in a bright modern clinic
an Aboriginal mother and toddler meeting a friendly child health nurse in a welcoming family room
an Aboriginal Australian elder and a patient benefits adviser working through a blank paper form in a light office

an Aboriginal Australian woman chatting with a female health worker in a garden courtyard
four Aboriginal Australian women of different adult ages yarning over tea on a light filled community veranda
three Aboriginal Australian community organisation colleagues collaboratively planning at a timber office table with plain notebooks
an Aboriginal Australian young adult learning carpentry with an older mentor in an airy workshop wearing appropriate safety glasses
an Aboriginal Australian family and community worker sharing a practical planning conversation in a community centre lounge
a small adult walking group with an Aboriginal Australian guide on a Blue Mountains bush trail, no sacred sites or symbols
an Aboriginal Australian elder and two young adults sharing conversation on a eucalyptus shaded coastal bush walk
an Aboriginal Australian career adviser reviewing a resume on a laptop with a young adult in a welcoming office
a friendly housing support worker welcoming an adult at a light community reception desk
a young adult and counsellor in a calming sunlit room with a sage sofa and plants, equal relaxed conversation
a friendly adviser helping an adult understand a government form at a clean bright service centre desk
a registered nurse wearing a headset in a quiet bright Australian telehealth office

a parent and family counsellor having a relaxed conversation with a child playing nearby in a welcoming room
